title: MicroWorld: Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models to Bridge the Microscopic Domain Gap with Multimodal Attributed Property Graph
abstract: arXiv:2605.10120v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show remarkable potential for scientific reasoning, yet their performance in specialized domains such as microscopy remains limited by the scarcity of domain-specific training data and the difficulty of encoding fine-grained expert knowledge into model parameters. To bridge the gap, we introduce MicroWorld, a framework for structured-knowledge augmentation with a complementary visual retrieval pathway, using a multimodal attributed property graph (MAPG) without domain-specific fine-tuning. translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在科学推理方面展现出巨大潜力，但其在显微镜学等专业领域的表现仍受限于领域特定训练数据的稀缺，以及将细粒度专家知识编码进模型参数的困难。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 MicroWorld，一个利用多模态属性性质图（MAPG）进行结构化知识增强并辅以互补视觉检索通路的框架，且无需领域特定微调。MicroWorld 通过 scispaCy 或基于 LLM 的三元组挖掘抽取生物医学实体与关系，使用 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 在共享嵌入空间中对齐图像与实体，并构建了一个包含约 10.6 万个节点、262 万条带类型边、涵盖八种关系类别的知识图谱。在推理阶段，图增强检索管线将查询实体匹配到 MAPG，并注入（后续内容被截断）……
tldr: MicroWorld 提出了一种基于多模态属性性质图（MAPG）的结构化知识增强框架，通过包含约 10.6 万节点和 262 万条边的生物医学知识图谱检索与互补的视觉检索通路，使多模态大语言模型无需领域微调即可跨越显微成像等专业领域的知识鸿沟。
en_tdlr: MicroWorld introduces a structured knowledge augmentation framework based on a multimodal attributed property graph (MAPG) with a complementary visual retrieval pathway, enabling multimodal LLMs to bridge the microscopy domain gap without domain-specific fine-tuning.
